convention: Deployment parameters exclude fixed transform buffers; learned frozen thresholds are listed separately. Dense Conv/ConvTranspose includes fixed kernels and zero entries; 1 MAC=2 ops; bias=1/output; PReLU/LeakyReLU=2/output; Sigmoid=4/output; Pow/Sqrt=1/output; mean=input elements; max reduction=input-output elements; data movement=0 arithmetic ops. Cast/GatherElements have zero arithmetic cost in this convention. If TopK is present with --allow-selection, arithmetic_ops is null and known_arithmetic_ops explicitly excludes its comparison/selection cost. Algorithmic estimate, not hardware instruction count or DLC storage size.
